| <a id="cli-import"></a>[valija import [options] <file>](../../../src/delivery/cli/build-program.ts) | Import chatbot history (ChatGPT/Claude/generic export) into the vault. | `-p, --project <project>` target project (required to import; created if new); `--from <source>` chatgpt \| claude \| generic (auto-detected if omitted); `--list` list conversations and exit (the default when no selection is given); `--pick <spec>` 1-based indices/ranges into the list, e.g. 1,3-5; `--query <text>` select conversations whose title contains this text; `--since <date>` select conversations on or after YYYY-MM-DD; `--all` import every conversation; `--dry-run` report what would be imported; write nothing | [ImportConversations](use-cases.md#symbol-importconversations) | — |
